fieldNotes.location: Roster address (5301 Polk St) was wrong/approximate. Web research (TruckMap, iBegin, Kompass, Waze) places KDP/Dr Pepper Bottling Co of Houston at 2400 Holly Hall St, Houston TX 77054 (Almeda Rd & Holly Hall). Satellite confirms a large beverage warehouse/plant with silos and an extensive trailer yard at 29.6838,-95.3940.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck yard, docks and trailers are entirely inside a fully-enclosed chain-link perimeter topped with barbed wire (clearly visible on the west building wall and around the NW corner). The truck entrance is a gated driveway at the NW corner off Holly Hall St. An enclosed barbed-wire urban compound of this type operates a controlled gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No clearly identifiable multi-sided guard booth straddling the truck lane could be confirmed from Street View (2024-06) or satellite. A small structure sits near the NW driveway but its function (booth vs. utility) is not certain - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the basis that a controlled gate exists but no staffed booth was confirmed; if a manned booth is present this should flip. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tractor-trailers were observed queued/parked along the Holly Hall St curb in multiple Street View captures, and the gate driveway is short - a truck queue at the gate spills directly onto the public street.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: The NW gate-to-dock approach is short; the building footprint occupies most of the parcel leaving little internal stacking depth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~25-40 doors from z18-z19 imagery across the south and east building faces - many trailers backed in. Indirect overhead count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard wrapping the south and east of the building - dozens of parked trailers (blue/white), well over 50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks appear on the south and east faces; could not confirm whether these are functionally separate shipping vs. receiving clusters - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs in the SH-288 corridor immediately east of the property but no spur enters the site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense urban Houston (Medical Center / Astrodome area) - surrounded by apartment complexes and other industrial buildings.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Compact urban parcel - perimeter measured at roughly 23 acres.
